meta.title: Update lower builtin folding and TPC-DS IR outputs
meta.body_summary: Add support for constant folding of the `lower` builtin in the VM compiler, and regenerate TPC-DS query IR outputs for q50–q59 to match the updated compiler behavior.

perf_labels.notes: Single-commit compiler optimization with auto-generated IR outputs, self-merged within 43 seconds with no review or performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 386 changed lines, this appears medium-sized but the actual logic change is only 9 lines in vm.go; the rest are 10 TPC-DS IR output files updated to reflect the constant folding. The PR fits a trivial, low-risk compiler tweak and was merged instantly without review, consistent with self-merge of a routine optimization.

review_details.concern_detail: No review feedback provided; PR was merged by the author without any external comments or formal review.
review_details.performance_claim: Constant folding of the `lower` builtin reduces runtime evaluation overhead by computing constant string lowering at compile time.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent added a small, well-understood optimization in a VM compiler and correctly regenerated downstream IR test outputs. This falls within routine compiler enhancement capability for simple built-in folding.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiling, or before/after metrics are provided; only a narrative claim of constant folding support with TPC-DS IR outputs that must pass `go test`.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regression or review issue occurred; change was accepted and merged without incident.

core_change_summary.description: Added a new case for the `lower` builtin in the constant folding switch in runtime/vm/vm.go, and regenerated the expected IR output for TPC-DS queries q50–q59 to include the folded constants.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The 10 IR output files are TPC-DS test expectations that automatically reflect the compiler change; each file gains a few folded constant lines.
change_trajectory: Single commit adds constant folding for lower builtin and updates all affected IR output files.

collaboration_trajectory: PR was opened and self-merged by the author within approximately 43 seconds with no external review, comments, or linked issues.
